seoTitle: Privacy Contact Page and privacy.txt Generator
metaDescription: Build a privacy contact page and a security.txt-style privacy.txt with DPO, email, request form and policy links. Free, local.
intro: Generates a privacy contact page in HTML and a small text file with your privacy contacts.
why:
People who want to use their data rights need to find the right contact quickly. A dedicated page with the DPO, email, postal address and request form helps them, and so does a machine-readable file.

This tool builds both. The text file copies the look of security.txt but no standard defines a privacy.txt, so browsers and regulators do not read it automatically. Keep the page and your privacy policy consistent.
howTo: Fill in the organisation and contact details.
Copy the HTML into a page on your site.
Publish the text file at /.well-known/privacy.txt if you want to.
Link the page from your privacy policy and footer.

faq.a: No. It is an informal convention, modelled on security.txt (RFC 9116).

faq.q: Where should I link the page?
faq.a: In the footer and the privacy policy.
